messages.subject: Re: Data formatting for transects
parts:
I think it is most likely there is something peculiar in your data file(s) - you get that with Excel. Although your description is very clear as far as it goes, there is no clue from the message what might be wrong.
You might try reading the "traps" objects first with read.traps, and then combining with capture data using make.capthist - that will show where the problem is. There is no need to include the detection locations in the transect file.
Murray
